notes.title: "Pixel Game Maker Series Biggerman.io" released today, December 16!
notes.content:
"Pixel Game Maker Series Biggerman.io" released today, December 16!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41487854/dd4de90e8158cf12be182214d612e52bcda96140.gif[/img]

Biggerman.io is a competitive game where you have to get bigger and bigger and stomp out the enemy Biggerman!
You can also destroy objects with your gun!

Up to four players can play at the same time!
Let's destroy and stomp together!
